description:
Which carriers on your roster changed on or after a date, and what
changed: authority, insurance, out-of-service and the other tracked
fields, each with its old and new value. Paid, metered: a base price plus
a per-roster-entry price, both shown in get_catalog.

roster_usdot_numbers is your own list of USDOT numbers (non-empty, at
most settings.roster_screen_max_size distinct entries, currently 100:
over the limit is a free invalid_arguments, never a truncation). since is
an ISO date, YYYY-MM-DD. A roster entry that matches no carrier is
listed in roster_not_found but still counts toward the price. "Nothing
changed" is a complete answer and bills like any other; a roster where
no entry resolves is a free not_found.

How fresh this is: changes appear only when the underlying data is
refreshed (roughly weekly lately, with no committed schedule), so a
change made at FMCSA today may not be here yet. provenance.record_as_of
says how current the data is. Only real changes are returned (the
warehouse's one-time "field started being tracked" rows are not). At
most settings.roster_changes_max_rows changes come back, newest first;
truncated says whether more existed. Carries no contact information, and
no change to legal_name, dba_name, phone or email, same as
get_safety_history.
name: check_roster_changes
